verdict.rationale: Proton documents an official Proton Pass CLI. It supports create/read/update/delete of vaults and items and secure secret retrieval in scripts, deployments and CI/CD pipelines, which suits automated, AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documentation of agent-oriented features such as machine-readable output and non-interactive auth (evidence comes from a launch blog post, not reference docs).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: the CLI enables you to securely retrieve secrets and other items across scripts, deployments, and continuous integration/ continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
Create, read, update, and delete vaults
View, create, update, and delete items including passwords, secure notes, credit cards, identities, WiFi entries, custom items, and stored SSH-key items
